checkedAlternates.risk: Single quotation marks look like apostrophes.
checkedAlternates.resolution: An apostrophe marks possession or omission within a word (group-1), not a paired enclosing delimiter (group-4).
A semicolon joins closely related independent clauses internally (group-3), rather than terminating a sentence (group-2).
